title: ONSure Runtime Population Snapshot v1
description: 82_SCHEMA_AND_CROSS_CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION_SEQUENCE.md Wave 5 RuntimePopulationSnapshot. Aggregates every runtime-instance.v1.schema.json record observed for one deployment-revision.v1.schema.json at one exact moment -- doc71 SS2's 'CURRENT이면 runtime_population_complete=true' conditional requires this to be an exhaustive population claim (exact instance ID list + digest), not a sampled count.

runtime_population_complete.description: true only if every expected replica/instance for this deployment_revision_id was actually observed at observed_at -- a partial scrape must set this false.
